vulnerabilityAlerts.description: An advisory is not a routine bump: it is raised on its own, labelled, and not held back by the release-age delay that protects ordinary updates.

packageRules.description: The workspace catalog pins every external version exactly; a bump is one line in pnpm-workspace.yaml, so review them together rather than as a stream of pull requests.
Compose services and Dockerfiles move as a set: a base image and its pinned tag are one decision.
A tag is mutable; a digest is the bytes that actually ran. The image build is the one artifact whose base cannot be re-verified from the lockfile, so it is pinned by digest like everything else.
